name: pinned-rust-toolchain
goal: Ordinary Rust entry points use the toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml through rustup, whatever cargo is first on PATH; without rustup or the pin they fail and say so.

evidence: First cargo on PATH is a standalone 1.72 without fmt; no rustup shims. check:kernel exit 101, no such command fmt. Spec: specification/features/planned/pinned-rust-toolchain.md.
Unmodified PATH: bun run check:kernel exit 101, /tmp/harness-pinned-rust-red.log and root's /tmp/harness-default-toolchain-red.log. Selection tests: 5 failed on the placeholder.
pinnedToolchain asks rustup which and puts the toolchain bin first on PATH. scripts/rust.ts runs it; check:kernel, build-kernel and both tool commands use it. No version named.
